# Rosales Landscaping & Construction Inc

> Rosales Landscaping & Construction Inc is a California C-27 licensed contractor serving Napa, Vallejo, and surrounding North Bay communities. The company provides outdoor construction and landscape work for residential and commercial properties.

## Core services

- Landscaping and new landscape installation
- Pavers for patios, paths, and driveways
- Concrete exterior surfaces and preparation
- Retaining walls in stone and block
- Synthetic turf
- Fences and gates
- Drainage and irrigation
- Decks, stonework, and driveways
